Messages.Author: Justin Fang
Messages.Body:
When an ally without a listed hand damage (like Thadius Zho) is Immortally
Grappled, does it have no strike or a hand strike for 0 or what?

If you have PB: Chicago out, and can't stop others from stealing the blood
on it, can you just choose to transfer 0 blood from it to your pool each
untap?

--
Justin Fang (jus...@ugcs.caltech.edu)
This space intentionally left blank.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <5vnau0$j...@gap.cco.caltech.edu>,

jus...@ugcs.caltech.edu (Justin Fang) wrote:
>
> When an ally without a listed hand damage (like Thadius Zho) is Immortally
> Grappled, does it have no strike or a hand strike for 0 or what?

It gets no strike. (It doesn't even have a hand strike of 0).

> If you have PB: Chicago out, and can't stop others from stealing the blood
> on it, can you just choose to transfer 0 blood from it to your pool each
> untap?

Yes. Just choosing not to use it would be simpler (It does say "may" on
card text).

--

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:


I wish he could. Current RT ruling is that he has no hand strike, so
cannot use Lucky Blow (unless he uses it with a Melee Weapon).

The melee weapon would be based on zero hand damage.

(The difference is that Lucky Blow was still a hand strike, whereas
Bastard Sword is just adds on hand damage).

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)


